newsitem.title: USA: Rexene says accepts Huntsman due diligence.
newsitem.headline: Rexene says accepts Huntsman due diligence.

text.p: Rexene Corp said on Friday it would provide Huntsman Corp with the materials to complete a due diligence review on Rexene.
However, Andrew Smith, Rexene's chief executive, said a letter sent by Huntsman yesterday did not prove the company could fullly finance a $16 per share offer for Rexene.
"The letters furnished by your potential financing sources do not, as you know, commit them to provide any funds for an acquisition of Rexene," Smith said.
Rexene would agree to a due diligence review as soon as Huntsman signed a confidentiality agreement.
Huntsman said on Thursday it would make a final $16 per share offer for Rexene and that it could finance any deal.
